canonical_project: National Technology Data Center Park / Centro Nacional de Dados
owner: UNDP Guinea-Bissau; Government of Guinea-Bissau / ITMA
notes: UNDP Guinea-Bissau's 2025 annual report says National Data Center construction was launched. A UNDP tender notice for 'CONSTRUCTION OF NATIONAL TECHNOLOGY DATA CENTER PARK' was published 2025-09-15 under notice UNDP-GNB-00270. Guinea-Bissau's official digital transformation strategy calls for phased construction of a national data center in-country to support public digital platforms and private-sector infrastructure alternatives. Local reporting in March 2026 placed the site in Alto Bandim, Bissau, and described the project as Japan-funded and UNDP-implemented; capacity was not disclosed.
